newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil extends slide on newspaper comments.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil extends slide on newspaper comments.

text.p: Shares in Rentokil Initial Plc extended their fall on Thursday, hit by bearish comments in the Financial Times newspaper, dealers said.
Shares in the business services group were 6-1/2p weaker at 409 by 1021 GMT.
The influential Lex column in the Financial Times said Rentokil's annual results were disappointing and its growth outlook was slowing.
"From 1998, growth of 15 percent or even less looks likely," the newspaper said.

"As Rentokil comes down to earth, so should its rating," it said. "Even after yesterday's nine percent fall, the shares trade at a 30 percent premium to the market average on 1998 forecasts. That looks too high."
